prompt: Add a device management page where users can see all their registered devices and revoke specific ones. Each device shows name, last active time, and platform.

assertions.name: recognizes_api_need
assertions.description: Should recognize this involves backend API calls
assertions.check: Output mentions API, endpoint, backend, or ofetch

assertions.name: mentions_contract_discovery
assertions.description: Should mention reading Swagger or backend source
assertions.check: Output mentions Swagger UI, Controller, or DTO files

assertions.name: defines_zod_schema
assertions.description: Should define Zod schema for device data
assertions.check: Output shows Zod schema definition for device/device list

assertions.name: uses_lib_api_layer
assertions.description: Should use lib/api/ layer for API calls
assertions.check: Output mentions lib/api/ or creates file in that directory

assertions.name: error_handling_correct
assertions.check: Output uses error.data?.code for error extraction
